name: cursed
description: A theme so hostile it should require a waiver. Neon crimes, Zapfino, and an autocorrect that has never written code.

commands.title: Undo My Mistakes (restore my old settings)

enumDescriptions: Off. A normal editor, like a coward. Your theme and fonts are restored.
Mildly cursed. The color theme, plus occasional cursive, Comic Sans, and 3D anaglyph letters.

MAXIMUM. Everything above, plus Zapfino as your editor font, Papyrus in the terminal, and whole chunks of words that rotate, blur, invert, turn into dingbats, and sprout emoji. Strobes. Autocorrect outranks your real IntelliSense.
cursed.chaos.level.description: How cursed. The status bar pill cycles 0 to 1 to 2 and back to 0, applying and reverting your theme and fonts as it goes.

cursed.restoreTheme.description: Theme to return to when the chaos is switched off, if CURSED was already active when the extension first took a snapshot. Leave empty to fall back to the VS Code default.

cursed.chaos.mildIntensity.description: Fraction of visible characters cursed at level 1.

cursed.chaos.maxIntensity.description: Fraction of visible characters cursed at level 2. 1.0 is a war crime.

cursed.chaos.maxDecorations.description: Per-render cap on decorated runs, so your laptop survives. Level 2 triples this.

cursed.chaos.strobe.description: At MAXIMUM, reshuffle which characters are cursed on a timer.

cursed.chaos.strobeMs.description: Strobe interval in milliseconds. Below 1000 induces nausea.

cursed.autocorrect.enabled.description: Offer deeply confident, deeply wrong completions.

cursed.autocorrect.aggressive.description: Sort cursed suggestions ABOVE your real IntelliSense. Turn this off and they land at the bottom of the list, where you will never see them.

enumDescriptions: Rewrite words as you type, in unsaved buffers only. A file on disk cannot be mangled behind your back.
Rewrite words as you type, in every file. Each one is a single Cmd+Z to undo, but it does edit real code.
cursed.autocorrect.mutateScope.description: Whether autocorrect actually rewrites a word the moment you finish typing it, phone-autocorrect style.

cursed.autocorrect.mutateChance.description: Probability that a finished word gets mangled when mutate mode is on.
